summary: The UC Davis Mouse Biology Program supports researchers with genetically engineered mouse model generation, phenotyping, colony management, cryopreservation, and translational mouse biology services.
goals: drive inquiries from investigators and partners
ctaStyle: Favor clear, research-oriented calls to action that point investigators to services, collaboration pathways, or deeper program updates.

topPerformingPatterns: Lead with the scientific outcome or capability before program background
Use one concrete service or research example instead of a broad catalog
weakSignals: Long institutional intros before the scientific value
Multiple service mentions in one short post
correlations: Posts that tie a mouse model capability to disease relevance perform better than general awareness messaging

topPerformingPatterns: A short scientific hook followed by translational context improves dwell time
Service posts perform better when they explain how the capability accelerates research rigor or reproducibility
weakSignals: Overly promotional claims without scientific context
correlations: LinkedIn engagement is stronger when the second sentence explains why the model or service matters to the research workflow

topPerformingPatterns: A crisp capability-first hook with one research use case
Specific technical nouns outperform generic lab language
correlations: Shorter posts that name the model, phenotype, or service directly correlate with stronger click-through
